findings.passage: "Gun grabbers use so-called 'red flag laws' as a gateway to push their disarming agenda," Britt told 1819 News, following passage of the legislation in the House. "In reality, a 'red flag law' is an abridgment of the Second Amendment and can be abused to take away the right to self-defense with no due process. I do not support additional gun laws that infringe upon our Second Amendment rights. As Senator for Alabama, I will be a champion for preserving and strengthening our God-given Second Amendment rights."
findings.note: Statement to 1819 News (as a Senate candidate) after the House passed a red-flag bill; she says red flag laws can be abused and she does not support additional gun laws.

findings.passage: "I will introduce a bill to ensure that no state that implements an unlawful and unconstitutional red flag law can be entitled to federal dollars," Britt said. "Alabamians are proud to exercise our Second Amendment rights for hunting and self-defense — but that is not the purpose of the Second Amendment. The Second Amendment exists to protect citizens from tyranny. Armed citizens are empowered citizens. This is why liberals want to disarm populations to take control — without firearms, Americans can be pushed towards anything."
findings.note: Campaign pledge to bar federal money to states with red flag laws; says the Second Amendment exists to protect citizens from tyranny. Quoted by 1819 News.
subjects: federal funds and state red flag laws

findings.passage: "As you know, many Alabamians are proud to exercise their Second Amendment rights, and I am one of them," she said. "Many times, people discuss hunting and self-defense. Those things are very important. But the purpose of the Second Amendment, Jeff, is obviously to protect our citizens against tyranny of the government. Armed citizens are empowered citizens. You can look across our history, even at the current rate, and we know how important it is to make sure that our citizenry is armed and that Second Amendment is not infringed upon.
findings.note: Radio interview on Mobile's FM Talk 106.5 during the 2022 Senate campaign, as quoted by 1819 News (article dated 2022-04-14; interview was on a Tuesday that week).

findings.passage: When you look at the Second Amendment, and you look at what it says, 'shall not be infringed,' and I believe that wholeheartedly.
findings.note: Same radio interview, as quoted by 1819 News.

findings.passage: When it comes to the Second Amendment, Senator Britt as a constitutional conservative has always believed that restrictive gun control measures are contrary to both the letter and the spirit of our United States Constitution.
findings.note: Official Senate issues page, undated; states her view on gun control measures.

findings.passage: She believes that we need to enforce the laws already on the books, combat the growing culture of violence in society, and address the underlying mental health issues that often contribute to heinous, senseless crimes.
findings.note: Same official issues page; lists enforcing existing laws and mental health as her approach to gun violence.
